high_level_description: This image is a religious poster celebrating the feast day of St. Stephen on December 26th. The central figure is a man dressed in elaborate, ornate robes, which suggest he is a saint or a high-ranking figure, possibly a bishop or a martyr. His attire includes a white robe with gold trim and a green vestment with intricate patterns, indicating his importance and sanctity. The man is depicted in a moment of prayer or supplication, with his hands clasped together in front of him and his eyes looking upwards, as if addressing a higher power.
